enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to Armor Class, attack and damage rolls.
Healers Bounty: This shield has a small percentage chance to cast a Heal spell on you when you take damage.
Parrying +6: +6 Insight bonus to Armor Class, +6 Insight bonus to Saves.
Physical Sheltering +35: +35 Enhancement bonus to Physical Resistance Rating
Quality Resistance +2: Passive: +2 Quality bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.
Mithral: Mithral armor is one type lighter then normal. Arcane Spell Failure decreased by 10%. Maximum dexterity bonus increased by 2. Armor check penalty reduced by 3.

Legacy of Lorikk: While wearing two pieces from the Legacy of Lorikk set, you gain:+6% Artifact bonus to Fire, Force, Light and Positive Spell Crit Chance+30 Artifact bonus to Fire, Force, Light and Positive Spell Power

Legacy of Levikk: While wearing two pieces from the Legacy of Levikk set, you gain:+10% Artifact bonus to Armor Class+30 Artifact bonus to Physical Resistance Rating+75% Artifact bonus to Melee Threat Generation

enchantments.text: Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4 and/or Mythic Shield Boost +2 or +4
enchantments.tooltip: Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)Mythic Shield Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
